# WorthIt

> Worth it—or walk away. Snap an item on iPhone and see if the shelf price is worth it.

## Product
- Name: WorthIt
- Wordmark: WORTHIT
- Store listing: WorthIt AI Scanner
- Platform: iOS (iPhone / iPad)
- URL: https://isitworthit.io
- Privacy: https://isitworthit.io/privacy
- Terms: https://isitworthit.io/terms
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clockd-ai-scanner/id6772232502
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/getworthitapp/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@getclockdapp

## Core value
One photo answers: is this shelf price worth it? WorthIt shows a deal signal, a typical price range, and online comps (Amazon, Walmart, Target). Results are AI estimates, not live register prices.

## Also included
- Save: shelf price versus typical range and online comps
- Flip: resale range and profit estimate on the same scan
- Grocery list compare across nearby stores
- Receipt trips: log store, line items, and total after checkout

## Pricing
Free to download with a daily analysis limit. WorthIt Pro unlocks a higher daily limit and ad-free analyzing. No credit card required to download.
